qualifier: with miRNA transcription and processing
name: TGF-beta and BMP SMAD signalling with miRNA regulation
rationale: All members concern TGF-beta/BMP receptor-SMAD signalling and its regulation; BMP signalling and miRNA transcription/processing distinguish it from the TGFBR3, cancer-mutant, activin and fibrosis confusables.

core: Renal sodium and blood pressure regulation
qualifier: renin-angiotensin-aldosterone axis and adrenal steroidogenesis
name: Renin-angiotensin-aldosterone regulation of sodium and blood pressure
rationale: Members cover angiotensin generation and signalling, renal sodium handling, blood volume and pressure, plus aldosterone/corticosteroid synthesis, which separates it from the vasopressin/water and natriuretic confusables.

qualifier: synaptic vesicle docking and priming
name: Synaptic vesicle docking and priming in neurotransmitter release
rationale: All members are neurotransmitter release cycles or vesicle docking/priming/SNARE assembly, the pre-fusion stage that distinguishes it from confusables centred on calcium-triggered fusion and spontaneous release.

qualifier: UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid, SLC35 transporter defects
name: UDP-GlcNAc and CMP-sialic acid synthesis and Golgi transport
rationale: Members are hexosamine, sialic acid and UDP-glucuronate donor synthesis and nucleotide-sugar transporter (SLC35) defects, distinct from GPI, GDP-fucose, UDP-glucose/dolichol and glycan-elaboration confusables.

qualifier: eicosanoid and pro-resolving lipid mediator metabolism
name: Platelet haemostasis, coagulation and eicosanoid lipid mediator metabolism
rationale: Members span platelet activation, coagulation factors and fibrinolysis together with eicosanoid, resolvin and other lipid mediator synthesis and receptors; the lipid mediator arm distinguishes it from the platelet-integrin confusable that shares the haemostasis core.

qualifier: fatty acid beta-oxidation and branched-chain amino acid breakdown via 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases
name: Mitochondrial fatty acid and branched-chain amino acid acyl-CoA catabolism
rationale: Members are mitochondrial beta-oxidation, carnitine shuttle, ketone bodies, BCAA/lysine catabolism, PDH/OGDH/BCKDH complexes and their biotin/lipoate/CoA cofactors, unlike confusables centred on carnitine synthesis or cobalamin/thiamine/riboflavin vitamins.

qualifier: to UV and phorbol ester
name: Immediate-early stress gene response to UV and phorbol ester
rationale: Members are broad stimulus-induced transcriptional programmes (UV up/down, TNF-NF-kB, PI3K-AKT, NR4A, phorbol ester, nitric oxide); UV and phorbol ester responses distinguish it from the AP-1/JNK kinase and senescence confusables.

qualifier: NRF2- and HIF-driven
name: NRF2- and HIF-driven metabolic reprogramming under oxidative and hypoxic stress
rationale: Members are NFE2L2 and HIF transcriptional programmes controlling glycolysis, pentose phosphate and NADP metabolism, with p53 and mTORC1 metabolic outputs, unlike confusables on fructose glycolysis, FOXO, or ROS detoxification and ferroptosis.

qualifier: FGFR3
name: FGFR3 activation and downstream FRS/SHC signalling
rationale: All members concern FGFR3 ligand binding, activating mutants and FRS/SHC cascades, distinguishing it from FGFR1, FGFR2 and FGFR4 confusables.

qualifier: germ cell proliferation, meiotic entry and sperm motility
name: Germ cell proliferation, meiotic entry and sperm motility
rationale: Members cover primordial germ cell migration and proliferation, meiosis activation, Sertoli barrier and sperm mitochondrial sheath/flagellar motility, distinct from testis somatic and oocyte, axoneme assembly, and fertilization confusables.

qualifier: hexokinase phosphorylation and glucose-6-phosphatase linking glycogen
name: Glucose-6-phosphate formation and hydrolysis linking glycolysis and glycogen
rationale: Members are hexokinase/glucokinase, glucose-6-phosphatase system defects, hexose phosphate transport and glycogen regulation around glucose-6-phosphate, unlike fructose/gluconeogenesis and glycogen-synthesis disorder confusables.

qualifier: resistance to sorafenib, ponatinib, crenolanib, lestaurtinib, tandutinib, tamatinib
name: FLT3 mutants resistant to sorafenib, ponatinib, crenolanib, lestaurtinib, tandutinib, tamatinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutants resistant to specific kinase inhibitors; the particular inhibitor set separates it from KIT-resistant, other-FLT3-drug and FLT3 signalling confusables.

qualifier: nephric duct formation and bud elongation
name: Nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation and branching
rationale: Members concern nephric duct and ureteric bud formation, elongation, branching and ureter morphogenesis, distinct from intermediate mesoderm and metanephric mesenchyme/nephron confusables.

qualifier: global-genome NER incision and error-free POLH bypass
name: UV lesion repair by global-genome NER incision and POLH bypass
rationale: Members are UV response and pyrimidine dimer repair via GG-NER recognition/incision and error-free POLH translesion synthesis, unlike TC-NER, error-prone TLS and gap-filling confusables.

qualifier: NF-kB activation and type I interferon production
name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling to NF-kB and type I interferon
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signalling, NF-kB activation via TRAF6/FADD and IFN-alpha/beta induction, distinguished from confusables on RIG-I negative regulators, dsRNA response and viral evasion/IRF activation.

qualifier: fatty acid, eicosanoid and miscellaneous substrate classes
name: Cytochrome P450 oxidation of fatty acids, eicosanoids and miscellaneous substrates
rationale: The three members are cytochrome P450 enzyme sets grouped by substrate class, distinct from lipoxygenase, epoxygenase/omega-hydroxylase, cyclooxygenase and leukotriene pathway confusables.

core: Viral genome replication and host restriction
qualifier: coronavirus replicase and APOBEC cytidine deamination
name: Coronavirus replication-transcription and APOBEC cytidine-deamination antiviral restriction
rationale: Members combine SARS-CoV replicase translation, capping and genome replication with APOBEC3G/editosome cytidine deamination restricting viruses; the cytidine-deamination arm separates it from viral translation confusables and from ADAR A-to-I editing.

qualifier: eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2 permeability
name: Endothelial shear stress mechanotransduction and eNOS trafficking
rationale: Members are endothelial responses to laminar and oscillatory shear via PIEZO1, plus eNOS trafficking and VEGFR2 permeability, which distinguish it from osteocyte/hydrostatic, smooth muscle and integrin confusables.

qualifier: canalicular bile acid and phosphatidylcholine export
name: Phospholipid flipping and canalicular bile acid secretion
rationale: Members are phospholipid and sphingolipid translocation plus ABCB4/ABCB11 canalicular export defects and bile acid secretion, distinct from sterol ABCG5/8, lipoprotein and xenobiotic transport confusables.

qualifier: complex/hybrid N-glycan and mucin-type O-glycan, not fucosylation
name: Golgi N-glycan maturation and mucin-type O-glycan elongation
rationale: Members cover mannose trimming, complex/hybrid N-glycan branching, polylactosamine and sialylation, and O-GalNAc initiation/termination, unlike early ER N-glycosylation and fucose/blood-group confusables.

qualifier: topological, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink lesions
name: Replication fork stress from topological, R-loop and protein-DNA crosslink lesions
rationale: Members concern DNA topology changes, R-loop processing, fork reversal, protein-DNA crosslink repair and responses to camptothecin/hydroxyurea, distinct from replication initiation, recombination repair and telomere confusables.

qualifier: hydrogen peroxide-triggered intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis
name: Hydrogen peroxide-induced intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis regulation
rationale: Members regulate peroxide/hydroperoxide responses and resulting intrinsic apoptosis or ferroptosis, distinguished from respiration, nitrosative and hypoxia/ischaemia confusables by the peroxide and ferroptosis focus.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase activation of PI3K-AKT and ERK
qualifier: ALK and LTK
name: ALK/LTK tyrosine autophosphorylation driving PI3K-AKT and ERK signalling
rationale: Members are tyrosine autophosphorylation and PI3K-AKT/ERK activation with ALK/LTK (midkine, pleiotrophin) as the receptors, distinguishing it from PTK6, erythropoietin, MET and oncogenic fusion confusables.

core: Nucleoside and nucleotide transport and interconversion
qualifier: membrane nucleoside transporters and mitochondrial ADP/ATP exchange
name: Nucleoside and adenine nucleotide transport and phosphorylation interconversion
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane nucleoside/nucleobase transport (including nucleoside-analogue drugs), mitochondrial ADP/ATP carriage and nucleotide phosphorylation, unlike nucleotide catabolism/NUDT and creatine confusables.

qualifier: dendritic cell, plasma cell and Th1 cell
name: Dendritic cell and lymphocyte surface marker signatures
rationale: Members are surface signatures of dendritic cells, plasma cells and T cells with butyrophilin interactions, distinguished by dendritic-cell content from monocyte, B cell and T cell activation confusables.
